answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in walnut and nadir lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the anchor graph. A farm of 2873 identities would post 1173 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
